Name: Verify cart continue shopping button returns to products
Description: User should be able to return to products page from cart using continue shopping button

Name: Verify login fails for locked out user
Description: Login should fail for locked out user with appropriate error message

Name: Verify checkout with alternative user data
Description: Checkout should work with different user information

Name: Verify successful checkout with valid information
Description: User should be able to complete checkout with valid personal information

Name: Verify login fails with invalid credentials
Description: Login should fail with invalid credentials and show error message

Name: Verify cart contains correct item after adding product
Description: Cart should display the product that was added to it

Name: Verify product can be added to cart
Description: User should be able to add a product to cart from products page

Name: Verify products page displays products after login
Description: Products page should display all available products after successful login

Name: Verify successful login with valid credentials
Description: User should be able to login with valid credentials and see products page

Name: Verify checkout step one validates required fields
Description: Checkout should fail if required fields are empty

Name: Verify multiple products can be added to cart
Description: User should be able to add multiple products to cart
